account-information.file-smaller-than-2mb: File smaller than 10MB and at least 400px by 400px

modal-enable-two-factor.two-factor-authentication-makes: Two Factor Authentication makes your OnlyChat account safer, by asking for a temporary code upon login. The code is generated by a TOTP app on your mobile phone.
modal-enable-two-factor.if-you-lose-your-phone: If you lose your phone, you will be locked out of your account. Thus, you should back up your TOTP key. We advise tht your write the private key we will provide next step on a piece of paper.
modal-enable-two-factor.scan-this-with-your: Scan this with your authentication app
modal-enable-two-factor.if-you-are-unable: If you are unable to scan the code, you can also install the following private key in your authentication app. You may also backup it on paper.
modal-enable-two-factor.to-ensure: To ensure your private key is correctly installed, please enter the 6 digit code that your authentication app generates below.
modal-enable-two-factor.two-factor-authentication-has-been-enabl: Two Factor Authentication has been enabled

modal-change-password.please-verify-you: Please verify you OnlyChat credentials with one of the following methods
modal-change-password.now-generate-OnlyChat: Now, generate OnlyChat account password to verify your identity.
modal-change-password.please-enter-your-onlychat-password: Please enter your OnlyChat account password
modal-change-password.please-verify-you-onlychat-credentials: Please verify you OnlyChat credentials with one of the following methods
modal-change-password.you-have-verify-yourself: You have verified yourself. Now, submit to proceed this action.

modal-delete-account.all-account-data-will-be: All account data will be permanently deleted and non-recoverable. There is no coming back after you press delete.

modal-disable-two-factor.no-step-code: No 2-step code will be asked at login anymore. Be warned: your account will be less secure against password theft.
